project_type.description: The entry type whose people get a note when an entry is published (projects, pieces, releases).

people_field.description: The field on that entry type that names the people who helped, as the last part of each person's entry web address, separated by commas.

person_type.description: The entry type used for people.

role_field.description: The field on a person that says what they do, so each note can say what they did.

draft_entry_type.description: The entry type each note is drafted as.

draft_body_field.description: The text field on that entry type where the note goes.
